decisions.reason: The modular plant concept (MMAK) is central to the firm's announced direction of modular, cleaner solutions, is publicly promoted with a quantified savings claim of over 600,000 euros a year, and represents substantial investment, so management will persist with it.
The slow-speed shredder sits close to the core offer, has its own dedicated page that signals strong public commitment, and fits the firm's growth and investment, so dropping it is very unlikely.

This second modular plant concept is only mentioned on the website and may overlap with A, but it fits the announced modular strategy, and early results can still be attributed to market ramp-up, so the firm keeps it.
The mobile trommel screen is a close extension of the established product line with sunk development and production investment, so the firm continues it as part of its core portfolio.
